news.title: Meta apologizes for suspending ‘No Kings’ Instagram account, blaming bot traffic increase
news.summary: Facebook’s parent company Meta on Sunday apologized for suspending the “No Kings” Instagram account, saying the suspension was caused by a high increase in traffic by bots.
